questions.subject: Evidence
questions.question:
A plaintiff sued an equipment supplier for breach of contract. The plaintiff alleged that the supplier failed to deliver equipment according to the terms of a contract between the parties. The supplier responded by general denial. At the time the suit was filed, the original contract was located at the supplier's corporate office. No copies of the contract exist. At trial, prior to calling the plaintiff to testify, the plaintiff's attorney asked the supplier's attorney for the contract so that the terms could be recited to the jury. The supplier's attorney responded that the contract remained at the supplier's office and that the supplier was not obligated to produce it. The plaintiff's attorney then sought to have the plaintiff testify to the contract's terms.
The supplier has objected to the plaintiff's testimony on the ground that it violates the best evidence rule.
Should the testimony be admitted?

choices.A: No, because the plaintiff bears the burden of proof in the contract dispute and therefore must produce his own documentary evidence of the contract.
choices.B: No, because the plaintiff did not specifically request that the supplier produce the contract at trial.
choices.C: Yes, because the best evidence rule does not apply.
choices.D: Yes, because the plaintiff alleged that the contract's terms were breached.

questions.explanation:
Party-opponent in possession of original document
(FRE 1004(c))

Court may admit other evidence of content when party against whom original would be offered:

  • had control of original
  • was put on notice that original would be subject of proof at trial and
  • failed to produce original
FRE = Federal Rule of Evidence.

The best evidence rule (ie, original document rule) applies when a witness relies on a document's contents while testifying or when the contents of a document are at issue, such as when the document has a legal effect (eg, contracts). This rule generally requires that an original or reliable duplicate of a recording, writing, or photograph be produced to prove its contents. The best evidence rule does apply here because the contents of the contract are at issue in this breach-of-contract case (Choice C).

However, an exception allows other evidence of the document's content (eg, testimony) to be admitted when the party against whom the original would be offered:

  • had control of the original
  • was put on notice (by pleadings or otherwise) that the original would be a subject of proof at trial and
  • failed to produce the original at trial.

Here, the equipment supplier had control of the original contract and failed to produce it at trial. The supplier was also put on notice by the plaintiff's pleadings, which alleged that the supplier breached the terms of the contract. Therefore, the plaintiff's testimony concerning the contract's terms is admissible. The plaintiff was not required to specifically request that the supplier produce the contract at trial (Choice B).

(Choice A) Although the plaintiff bears the burden of proof in this contract dispute, the plaintiff's testimony is admissible because the supplier was on notice and failed to produce the contract.

📌 Educational Objective

One exception to the best evidence rule allows a party to introduce other evidence of a document's content when the party against whom the original would be offered (1) had control of the original, (2) was put on notice that the original would be a subject of proof at trial, and (3) failed to produce the original at trial.

📚 References
  • Fed. R. Evid. 1002–07 (best evidence rule).

zh-choices.B: 不应采纳，因为原告并未在审判中明确要求供应商出示该合同。
zh-choices.C: 应采纳，因为最佳证据规则（best evidence rule）不适用。

MBE 考点解析

Evidence: Writings, Recordings, and Photographs - Requirement of original

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：合同内容被拿来证明违约时，最佳证据规则（best evidence rule）是否允许用证人证词代替原件。

三秒认题路径：

合同内容成争点 → 原件在对方手里 → 对方被告知 → 仍不出示 → 证词可进

核心法律规则

当证人要证明的是文件内容（contents of a writing），而不是只是顺带提到文件时，就会碰到原件规则（original document rule）。考场意思：这时通常要拿原件或可靠副本来证明内容。

但如果原件掌握在对方当事人手里，且对方已经被通知（notice）该文件会在审判中成为证明对象，却还是不拿出来，法院可以收其他证据（other evidence），包括证人对内容的转述。考场意思：对方不交原件，你就不用被原件规则卡死。

这里合同条款正是违约争点，供应商持有原件、被起诉书内容通知到、又拒绝出示，所以原告可以用证词证明合同条款。

核心判例： FRE 1004(c) 的思路锁定本题：对方掌控原件、已被通知、却未出示时，其他证据可用来证明文件内容。

思维导图

先问：原告是在证明“合同内容”吗？
是 → 触发最佳证据规则（best evidence rule），默认要原件或可靠副本。
再查例外 → 原件在被告手里；起诉书已让被告知道合同会成为证明对象；被告却没带来。
卡死点：effectively unreviewable式思路不适用；这里是“对方不交原件”的证据例外，证词可以进。
结论 → 允许原告就合同条款作证，选 Yes。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：原告在合同纠纷里有举证责任，所以他自己没拿出原件，就不能讲合同内容。

但考试真正问的是：原件是否被对方掌控、是否已被通知、是否仍拒绝出示，不是谁最后要赢这场官司。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的原件有没有先放在谁家」。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 D？

题干合同原件在被告处且被告被通知后仍不出示，正落入原件规则例外，所以原告可以用证词讲合同条款。

❌ 概念混淆 | 举证责任误判

✕ A: 把举证责任当成原件义务，burden of proof 不是这里的卡点。

❌ 事实误判 | 先行请求误判

✕ B: 误以为一定要先当庭正式催交原件，题干里的起诉主张本身已够通知。

❌ 法律适用 | 规则否定误判

✕ C: 直接说best evidence 不适用，和题干“合同内容成争点”正面冲突。

这题建议用什么方法？

先看证据是不是在证明文件内容，再找原件是否被对方控制并且已被通知。

考场速记

记住这句：原件规则先看“内容是否在争”；若原件在对方手里、对方已被通知却不交，other evidence 就能上场。

questions.subject: Evidence
questions.question:
A plaintiff sued a defendant for breach of contract, claiming that the defendant failed to pay the plaintiff for services rendered under the contract between the parties. At trial, without offering the contract or accounting for its absence, the plaintiff seeks to admit a portion of the defendant's deposition testimony in which the defendant recited the terms of the contract.
The defendant has objected to the deposition testimony on the ground that it violates the best evidence rule.
Should the defendant's deposition testimony be admitted?

choices.A: No, because a statement by a party-opponent cannot be used to prove the contents of a writing.
choices.B: No, because the original contract must be used to prove the terms of the contract.
choices.C: Yes, because the best evidence rule does not apply.
choices.D: Yes, because the defendant's deposition testimony can be used against him to prove the terms of the contract.

questions.explanation:
Overview of best evidence rule
General rule Must produce original or reliable duplicate† to prove contents of document relied on by witness or whose contents are at issue
Exceptions
Other evidence can be used to prove content if:
Original unavailable
  • originals lost or destroyed (not by proponent's bad faith)
  • originals not attainable by judicial process
  • opponent had original, knew it was required & failed to produce
  • or content not closely related to controlling issue
Admission by party Contents can be proven by opposing party's testimony, deposition, or written statement
Public record Contents of public record can be proven by:
  • certified copy
  • copy of records & comparison testimony
  • or other evidence if above proof is not reasonably obtainable

†Duplicates are admissible unless original's authenticity is questioned or it would be unfair to admit them.

The best evidence rule (ie, original document rule) applies when a witness relies on a document's contents while testifying or when the contents of a document are at issue, such as when the document has a legal effect (eg, contracts, wills). This rule generally requires that an original or reliable duplicate of a recording, writing, or photograph (referred to as "document") be produced to prove its contents. However, there are some exceptions. A common exception requires the proponent of the evidence to prove that all originals are lost, destroyed, or otherwise unattainable before allowing the use of other evidence to prove the document's contents (not seen here). But another exception allows a party to prove a document's contents through the testimony, deposition, or written statement of a party-opponent without accounting for the document's absence. Since the defendant's deposition testimony concerning the contract terms falls under this exception, it should be admitted over the defendant's objection (Choices A & B).

(Choice C) The best evidence rule does apply because the contents of the contract are at issue in this breach-of-contract case.

📌 Educational Objective

The best evidence rule requires that an original or reliable duplicate of a recording, writing, or photograph be produced to prove its contents. But one exception allows a party to instead prove the contents of a document through the testimony, deposition, or written statement of the party against whom the evidence is offered.

📚 References
  • Fed. R. Evid. 1002–07 (best evidence rule).

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Evidence: Writings, Recordings, and Photographs - Best evidence rule

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：最佳证据规则（best evidence rule）下，对方当事人陈述（admission by party-opponent）可以直接拿来证明合同内容，不必先拿出原件。

三秒认题路径：

合同内容在争 → 原件规则先想起 → 但看对方自己说过 → 例外可直接用 → 选可采

核心法律规则

只抓本题要用的规则

最佳证据规则（best evidence rule）的默认要求是：当你要证明的是一份文件（writing）的内容时，通常要出示原件或可靠副本，不能只拿别的证据替代。

但有一个关键例外：如果要证明文件内容的是对方当事人的陈述（admission by party-opponent），可以用对方的证言（testimony）、口供（deposition）或书面陈述直接证明，不用先解释原件去哪了。

所以这题里，原告拿被告自己的deposition来讲合同条款，正好落进这个例外，best evidence rule不会挡住它。

核心判例： Fed. R. Evid. 1002–1007 —— 这组规则把“原件要求”和“对方当事人陈述例外”一起锁死了本题结论。

思维导图

先问：原告是不是在用别的证据证明“合同条款内容”?
是默认要原件或可靠副本。
再查例外是不是对方当事人陈述（admission by party-opponent）？
卡死点：这里不用先找原件；被告自己的 deposition 就能证明合同内容。
结论被告对该 deposition 的 best evidence objection 失败，证据可采。
答案选 D。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：既然在证明合同条款，当然得先把原合同拿出来。

但考试真正问的是：这是不是已经掉进对方当事人陈述（admission by party-opponent）这个例外；一旦是，就不需要先找原件。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，不是「物理上的秘密有没有泄露」。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 D？

题干抓的是被告自己的 deposition 来讲合同条款，正好属于对方当事人陈述例外，所以可以直接证明内容。

❌ 概念混淆 | 规则渊源误判

✕ A: 把party-opponent当成不能证明内容，方向反了。

❌ 法律适用 | 原件绝对化

✕ B: 只记住“要原件”，却漏了对方当事人陈述这个例外。

❌ 事实误判 | 例外漏看

✕ C: 说best evidence rule不适用，但题干正是在证明合同内容。

这题建议用什么方法？

先抓“证的是不是文书内容”，再立刻找“对方当事人陈述”例外。

考场速记

记住一句话：原件规则先看默认，再找例外；只要是对方当事人自己说的内容，常常就能直接上，不必死等原件。

questions.subject: Evidence
questions.question:
A plaintiff sued a defendant for breach of contract. At a jury trial, the plaintiff testified that the original contract was destroyed in a fire at his office that was caused by faulty electrical wiring. The plaintiff further testified that no copies of the contract exist. Over the defendant's objection, the judge allowed the plaintiff to testify as to the terms of the contract. The defendant then testified that no contract between the parties was ever executed and, on that basis, moved to strike the plaintiff's testimony regarding the contract from the record.
How should the court proceed?

choices.A: The court must deny the motion, because a party may properly prove the terms of the contract by testimony.
choices.B: The court must deny the motion, because whether there was a contract between the parties is a question for the jury.
choices.C: The court may grant the motion, provided it is convinced that a contract between the parties never existed.
choices.D: The court must grant the motion, because the original contract was never produced.

questions.explanation:
Overview of best evidence rule
General rule Must produce original or reliable duplicate* to prove contents of document relied on by witness or whose contents are at issue
Exceptions
Other evidence can be used to prove content if:
Original unavailable
  • originals lost or destroyed (not by proponent's bad faith)
  • originals not attainable by judicial process
  • opponent had original, knew it was required & failed to produce
  • or content not closely related to controlling issue
Admission by party Contents can be proven by opposing party's testimony, deposition, or written statement
Public record Contents of public record can be proven by:
  • certified copy
  • copy of records & comparison testimony
  • or other evidence if above proof is not reasonably obtainable

*Duplicates are admissible unless original's authenticity is questioned or it would be unfair to admit them.

The best evidence rule requires that an original or reliable duplicate of a recording, writing, or photograph (referred to as the "document") be produced to prove its contents. However, a party may use other, secondary evidence (eg, testimony) to prove a document's contents if certain factual conditions are established (eg, all originals are lost or destroyed).

Whether a party has fulfilled the factual conditions for admitting secondary evidence is ordinarily a determination for the court. But in a jury trial, the jury determines any issue about whether:

  • an asserted document ever existed
  • another document produced at a hearing or trial is the original
  • or other evidence of content accurately reflects the document's content.

Here, the plaintiff testified that the original contract was destroyed and no duplicate exists, so the court allowed the plaintiff to testify to the contract's terms in lieu of producing the original contract (Choice D). The defendant then testified that no contract was ever executed, thereby raising an issue that the jury must decide. The court should therefore deny the defendant's motion to strike the plaintiff's testimony so that the jury can consider the evidence on this issue (Choice A).

(Choice C) Even if the court was convinced that no contract existed, it could only decide this issue if a directed verdict was warranted — ie, if there was no legally sufficient evidence for a reasonable jury to reach a different conclusion. Since a reasonable jury could find that a contract existed, the court must allow the jury to resolve this issue.

📌 Educational Objective

The court ordinarily determines whether factual conditions allow the admission of secondary evidence to prove a document's contents. But in a jury trial, the jury determines any issues of whether (1) the document ever existed, (2) another document is the original, or (3) other evidence of content accurately reflects the document's content.

📚 References
  • Fed. R. Evid. 1008 (functions of court and jury).

zh-choices.C: 法院可以批准该动议，前提是法院确信双方之间从未存在过合同。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Evidence: Writings, Recordings, and Photographs - Best evidence rule

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：最佳证据规则（best evidence rule）里，原件已毁时能不能用证人证言证明合同内容，以及“合同到底存不存在”是不是法官现在就能一锤定音。

三秒认题路径：

原件烧毁 → 证言补证 → 存不存在 → 该谁决定 → 选 B

核心法律规则

最佳证据规则（best evidence rule）的意思是：当你要证明一份文件（writing）的内容时，通常要交原件或可靠副本。若原件已被非恶意毁掉，次级证据（secondary evidence）可以上场，比如证人回忆合同条款。

但这里有个考场分工：法官先看“能不能用次级证据”，陪审团（jury）再决定“这份合同到底有没有存在过”、是不是原件、以及证言是否真的反映文件内容。换句话说，这题不是在问“原件没了还能不能说”，而是在问“被告说根本没合同时，法官能不能把这个争议直接拿走”。

核心判例： Fed. R. Evid. 1008 — 关于“文件是否存在”与“内容是否准确反映”的争议，通常留给陪审团，而不是法官提前裁掉。

思维导图

先问：这是不是在争“文书内容”要不要靠原件证明？
是合同条款要靠原件或可靠副本。
原件是否已丢失或被毁，而且不是故意不用？
是可改用次级证据（secondary evidence），例如证言讲条款。
但现在争的是“合同是否真的存在过”吗？
这一步不能被法官直接杀掉；陪审团（jury）来决定。
所以不能因为被告说“从没签过”就撤掉原告的证言。
结论：原告证言先留在案卷里，答案选 B。
误区把“原件没交”误当成“证言必删”。
错，原件缺失不等于事实争议消失；Fed. R. Evid. 1008 让陪审团决定“到底有没有那份合同”。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：既然原件已经烧掉，法院就该把原告关于合同条款的证言全删掉。

但考试真正问的是：被告主张“根本没签合同”时，这已经变成事实存在争议，不是单纯的证据形式问题。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的原件有没有消失」。

所以别把“原件不在”误听成“法官现在就能宣布合同不存在”。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 B？

题干的原件已毁且无副本只解决了能否用证言证明内容；被告又争“合同是否存在”，这项事实要留给陪审团，所以法院应驳回删证请求。

❌ 概念混淆 | 规则渊源误判

✕ A: 把“能用证言补内容”偷换成“证言当然永远有效”。

❌ 法律适用 | 法官越权误判

✕ C: 法官不能先替陪审团判定合同不存在。

❌ 事实误判 | 原件必交偷换

✕ D: original 没交，不等于一定要删掉替代证据。

这题建议用什么方法？

先分清“证据能否替代原件”和“事实存不存在”两个层次，再看谁有最终决定权。

考场速记

记住一句：原件规则管“怎么证明内容”，陪审团规则管“事实到底存不存在”。

这类题先想 Fed. R. Evid. 1008：原件毁了不必立刻出局，但“合同有没有成立”通常不是法官一句话就能结束。

questions.subject: Evidence
questions.question:
A plaintiff sued a freight company for damages incurred when the freight company's driver negligently destroyed the plaintiff's cargo in a trucking accident. Among the contested issues is the amount of the plaintiff's cargo on the freight company's truck at the time of the accident. At trial, the freight company manager testified that the company creates and keeps a detailed manifest for each load of cargo it transports. The manager further testified that the manifest for the cargo at issue was destroyed in a flood at the company's office but that he carefully reviewed the manifest prior to its destruction. The court allowed the manager to testify to the content of the manifest. The freight company then requested that the court instruct the jury that it must accept that the manager's testimony accurately reflects the content of the manifest.
Should the court issue the requested instruction?

choices.A: No, because whether the manager's testimony accurately reflects the manifest's content is a question for the jury.
choices.B: No, unless the court first determines that the manager's testimony accurately reflects the manifest's content.
choices.C: Yes, because the manifest was not destroyed by the freight company in bad faith.
choices.D: Yes, because the manifest was prepared prior to the event giving rise to the litigation.

questions.explanation:
Functions of court & jury under FRE 1008 (admitting other evidence of content)
Court Determines whether proponent has fulfilled factual conditions for admitting other evidence of content of writing, recording, or photograph
Jury Determines any issue about whether:
  • asserted writing, recording, or photograph ever existed
  • another writing, recording, or photograph produced at a hearing or trial is the original or
  • other evidence of content accurately reflects the content
FRE = Federal Rule of Evidence.

The best evidence rule requires that an original or reliable duplicate of a recording, writing, or photograph (referred to as the “document”) be produced to prove its contents. However, a party may use other, secondary evidence (eg, testimony) to prove a document’s contents if certain factual conditions are established (eg, all originals are lost or destroyed). Whether these conditions are met is a determination for the court. But in a jury trial, the jury determines any issue about whether:

  • an asserted document ever existed
  • another document produced at a hearing or trial is the original
  • or other evidence of content accurately reflects the document’s content.

Here, the amount of the plaintiff’s cargo on the freight company’s truck is a contested issue. The freight company manager testified that the manifest for the cargo at issue was destroyed in a flood at the company’s office but that he carefully reviewed the manifest prior to its destruction. The court allowed the manager to testify to the content of the manifest. The freight company then requested that the court instruct the jury that it must accept that the manager’s testimony accurately reflects the content of the manifest. Whether the manager’s testimony accurately reflects the manifest’s content is solely for the jury. The jury is free to conclude that the testimony does not accurately reflect the manifest’s content. Therefore, the court should not issue the requested instruction. (Choice B) The court is not required to first determine that the manager’s testimony accurately reflects the manifest’s content.

(Choice C) Although the manifest was not destroyed by the freight company in bad faith, that fact relates to whether the court should allow the manager’s testimony in lieu of the original manifest. It does not support the freight company’s request for the improper instruction.

(Choice D) The fact that the manifest was prepared prior to the event giving rise to the litigation is not a basis for the court to issue the improper instruction.

📌 Educational Objective

The court ordinarily determines whether factual conditions allow the admission of secondary evidence to prove a document’s contents. But in a jury trial, the jury determines any issues of whether (1) the document ever existed, (2) another document is the original, or (3) other evidence of content accurately reflects the document’s content.

📚 References
  • Fed. R. Evid. 1002–07 (best evidence rule).

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Evidence: Writings, Recordings, and Photographs - Requirement of original

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：原件规则（best evidence rule）下，法院允许用证言证明文件内容后，内容是否准确这个问题到底归法官还是陪审团。

三秒认题路径：

文件内容争议 → 原件丢失 → 允许次证 → 谁管准确性 → 陪审团

核心法律规则

这题只抓一条线

原件规则（best evidence rule）要求用原件或可靠副本证明文件内容；如果原件遗失或毁损，法院可以先判断是否满足使用其他证据的前提。

但在陪审团审理里，陪审团（jury）负责决定证言是否真的准确反映了文件内容，所以法官不能命令陪审团“必须接受”这份证言。

换句话说，法院管“能不能进”，陪审团管“信不信、准不准”。

思维导图

题干先问：能不能用次证证明 manifest 内容？
第一层：原件是否不能用？
原件被洪水毁掉 → 允许用经理证言替代。
第二层：谁来决定“证言准不准”？
卡死点：other evidence of content accurately reflects the content 由陪审团判断，不是法官强制命令。
结论：法庭可以放证据进来，但不能要求陪审团必须相信它。
所以正确答案：A

考点陷阱

你可能会想：原件都没了，法官既然已经放经理证言进来，就应该先确认这份证言“是真的”。

但考试真正问的是：准确反映内容（accurately reflects the content）这件事，到了陪审团阶段还是让陪审团自己判断，不是法官提前盖章。

法考看的是「证据规则上谁来判断」，而不是「经理讲得像不像真话」。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 A？

题干已经有 原件被洪水毁掉，真正剩下的问题是证言是否准确反映 manifest 内容；这一步由陪审团判断，法院不能强制要求接受。

❌ 概念混淆 | 法官陪审混判

✕ B: 把“能不能用次证”误当成“证言准不准”，多看一步了。

❌ 法律适用 | 恶意要件误搬

✕ C: bad faith 影响的是能否用次证，不会让法官替陪审团做真实性判断。

❌ 事实误判 | 时间点偷换

✕ D: 先前制作不等于内容必真，和本题的判断点没关系。

这题建议用什么方法？

先分清“法院准入”与“陪审团采信”，别把原件规则和证言可信度混成一件事。

考场速记

记住：原件规则（best evidence rule）里，法院管“是否允许用次证”，陪审团管“次证是否准确”。

口诀：能不能进，看法官；准不准，看陪审团。

questions.subject: Evidence
questions.question:
A defendant was charged with burglary. At trial, a police officer testified that, after the defendant had been arrested and had agreed to answer questions, the officer interrogated him with a stenographer present, but that the officer could not recall what the defendant had said. The prosecutor presented the officer with a photocopy of the stenographic transcript of the interrogation. After looking at it, the officer began to testify that he recalled that the defendant had admitted to being in the area of the burglary.
The defendant has objected to the officer's testimony on the ground that it violates the "original document" rule (also known as the "best evidence" rule).
Should the officer's testimony concerning the defendant's recorded confession be admitted?

choices.A: No, because a photocopy cannot be used without a showing that the original is unavailable.
choices.B: No, because the stenographer has not testified to the accuracy of the transcript.
choices.C: Yes, because a photocopy is a duplicate of the original.
choices.D: Yes, because the prosecutor is not attempting to prove the contents of the document.

questions.explanation:
A party may use any item (usually a writing) to refresh a witness's recollection if:

  • the witness once had personal knowledge of a fact or event but is now unable to recall it; and
  • the item will help the witness recall that information.

Use of a writing to refresh a witness's recollection does not implicate the best evidence rule最佳证据规则：要求提供原始书面文件、录音或照片以证明其内容；若不用于证明内容，则不适用。 because this rule only applies when a party is trying to prove the contents of the writing.

Here, the prosecutor is trying to prove what the defendant said during the interrogation - not the contents of the transcript. The officer cannot remember what the defendant said at the interrogation, but the officer once had personal knowledge of the interrogation because he was there and the transcript will help him recall it. Therefore, it is proper to refresh the officer's recollection with the transcript and admit his testimony.

(Choice A) The best evidence rule allows the admission of a reliable duplicate (eg, a photocopy) without a showing that the original is unavailable.

(Choice B) When a copy of a transcript is used to refresh a witness's recollection, the witness's subsequent testimony - not the transcript - is introduced into evidence. Therefore, a document used in this manner does not have to be accurate or reliable because the document is not being admitted.

(Choice C) Under the best evidence rule, a reliable duplicate is admissible to the same extent as the original unless:

  • a genuine question is raised about the original's authenticity or
  • the circumstances make it unfair to admit the duplicate.

This rule does not apply here because the prosecutor is not trying to prove the transcript's contents.

📌 Educational Objective

A writing may be used to refresh a witness's recollection if:

  • the witness once had personal knowledge of a fact or event but can no longer recall it; and
  • the writing can help the witness recall that information.

And since the writing is not being offered to prove its contents, this use does not implicate the best evidence rule.

📚 References
  • Fed. R. Evid. 612 (refreshed recollection).
  • Fed R. Evid. 1002-04 (best evidence rule).

MBE 考点解析

Evidence: Writings, Recordings, and Photographs - Recollection refreshed

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：用写作 刷新证人记忆（refreshed recollection） 时，最佳证据规则（best evidence rule） 通常不拦，因为这时法院听的是证人的现时回忆，不是文书内容本身。

三秒认题路径：

忘了细节 → 看稿回忆 → 证人作证 → 不是证据内容 → 不触发 best evidence

核心法律规则

如果证人以前确实知道这件事，但现在想不起来了，可以拿一份写作、录音或其他材料帮他回忆，这叫 刷新记忆（refresh recollection），考场意思：先让证人想起来，再由证人自己说。

最佳证据规则（best evidence rule） 只管“我要用文件内容来证明什么”时的原件问题，考场意思：如果你不是在证明那份稿子本身写了什么，就不会被它卡住。

所以本题里，检察官要证明的是被告当时说了什么，不是要证明速记稿的文字内容；光把复印件给证人看，是为了唤回记忆，之后上庭的是证人自己的回忆。

核心判例： Fed. R. Evid. 612 允许用材料刷新记忆；Fed. R. Evid. 1002-1004 只在争的是文书内容时才启动。

思维导图

先看：这份稿子是拿来证明“内容”吗？
NO
只是给证人看，帮他想起来
下一步
证人恢复记忆后，讲的是自己的回忆
最佳证据规则不拦：没有在证明文书内容
结论：证人证言可入证，选 D
YES
如果真要拿文书内容当证明对象
再查
才看原件、复印件、例外规则

考点陷阱

你可能会想：既然用了 photocopy，那就一定先看原件真不真、能不能拿复印件上庭。

但考试真正问的是：这次不是在拿稿子证明内容，而是在借稿子把证人脑子里的记忆叫回来。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的秘密有没有泄露」。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 D？

题干的 photocopy 只是用来唤回证人记忆；真正进证的是证人恢复后的口头回忆，不是在证明速记稿内容。

❌ 法律适用 | 原件要求误判

✕ A: 把 original 规则硬套到刷新记忆上了。

❌ 概念混淆 | 证明对象错认

✕ B: 盯着 accuracy 不放，但这里稿子不作为证据本身。

❌ 事实误判 | 复印件当核心

✕ C: 看到 duplicate 就以为当然可用，忽略了本题根本没在证明文书内容。

这题建议用什么方法？

先分清“刷新记忆”还是“证明文书内容”，再决定要不要碰最佳证据规则。

考场速记

记忆口诀：先让证人想起来，再让证人自己说；只要不是拿文书内容当证据，best evidence 通常不进场。

question_analysis.skill_tested: Distinguish refresh use from best evidence

keywords.text: could not recall what the defendant had said

reason.en: Triggers FRE 612 when the witness once had personal knowledge but cannot now remember.
reason.zh: 证人曾亲身知晓但现已无法回忆，触发规则612刷新记忆。

label.zh: 用于刷新记忆的书面材料

reason.en: The transcript is shown to the witness to jog memory, not offered for its contents.
reason.zh: 笔录用于唤起证人记忆，而非作为文书内容证据提出。

reason.en: Applies only when a party seeks to prove the contents of a writing.
reason.zh: 仅在当事人欲证明书面文件内容时才适用。

reason.en: Same doctrine as the best evidence rule raised by the objection.
reason.zh: 与异议所援引的最佳证据规则为同一规则。

reason.en: Establishes a written record exists but the officer personally witnessed the interrogation.
reason.zh: 表明存在书面记录，但警官本人曾亲历讯问。

reason.en: Officer had personal knowledge of the defendant's statements from being present.
reason.zh: 警官在场亲历，对被告陈述具有亲身知识。

label.zh: 复印件须证明原件不可用

reason.en: Misapplies best evidence duplicate rules to a non-content use of the writing.
reason.zh: 将最佳证据规则的复印件规则错误适用于非证明文书内容的情形。

reason.en: Assumes best evidence governs even when contents are not being proved.
reason.zh: 假定即使未证明文书内容，最佳证据规则仍适用。

reason.en: Treats the transcript as offered evidence requiring accuracy proof.
reason.zh: 将笔录视为须证明准确性的提出证据。

reason.en: Only the refreshed testimony is admitted; the transcript itself is not evidence.
reason.zh: 仅证人刷新后的证言被采纳，笔录本身并非证据。

reason.en: Correct duplicate law applied to the wrong evidentiary purpose.
reason.zh: 将正确的复印件规则适用于错误的证据用途。

D.text: prove the contents of the document

reason.en: Best evidence applies only when contents are the proposition to be proved.
reason.zh: 仅当待证事实为文书内容时，最佳证据规则才适用。

highlights.text: could not recall what the defendant had said

reason.en: Establishes the predicate for refreshing recollection under FRE 612.
reason.zh: 满足规则612刷新记忆的前提条件。

highlights.text: violates the "original document" rule (also known as the "best evidence" rule)

reason.en: Frames the dispute as whether best evidence bars the officer's testimony.
reason.zh: 界定争议为最佳证据规则是否排除警官证言。

highlights.text: presented the officer with a photocopy of the stenographic transcript

reason.en: Shows the transcript is a memory aid, not substantive documentary evidence.
reason.zh: 表明笔录是记忆辅助，而非实体性文书证据。

highlights.text: began to testify that he recalled that the defendant had admitted

reason.en: What is admitted is the officer's revived memory, not the transcript's contents.
reason.zh: 被采纳的是警官恢复的记忆，而非笔录内容本身。

questions.subject: Evidence
questions.question:
A plaintiff sued a defendant for unlawfully using the plaintiff's idea for an animal robot as a character in the defendant's science fiction movie. The defendant admitted that he had received a model of an animal robot from the plaintiff, but he denied that it had any substantial similarity to the movie character. After the model had been returned to the plaintiff, she destroyed it.
If the plaintiff seeks to testify to the model's appearance, what must she do prior to testifying?

choices.A: The plaintiff must give advance notice of her intent to introduce the oral testimony.
choices.B: The plaintiff must introduce a photograph of the model if one exists.
choices.C: The plaintiff must show that she did not destroy the model in bad faith.
choices.D: The plaintiff need do nothing because the "best evidence rule" applies only to writings, recordings, and photographs.

questions.explanation:
Best evidence rule
(FRE 1002–04)
Original (or reliable duplicate) of writing, recording, or photograph must be produced to prove its content unless:
  • all originals lost or destroyed by means other than proponent acting in bad faith
  • original cannot be obtained by judicial process
  • nonproponent had control of original & notice that original was required at trial or hearing, but failed to produce it
  • writing, recording, or photograph not closely related to controlling issue
FRE = Federal Rules of Evidence.

The best evidence rule generally requires that an original or reliable duplicate of a recording, writing, or photograph (collectively referred to as “document”) be produced to prove its contents. As a result, this rule only applies when a document’s contents are at issue—i.e., when:

  • the document is used to prove the happening of an event (e.g., video of bank robbery)
  • the document has a legal effect (e.g., audiotape of oral contract) or
  • the witness is testifying based on facts learned from the document (e.g., x-ray image), as opposed to personal knowledge (i.e., knowledge based on firsthand observations or experience).

Here, the best evidence rule does not apply because the plaintiff seeks to testify to her personal knowledge of the model’s appearance—not to prove the contents of a recording, writing, or photograph. And since a witness can testify to any relevant matter of which the witness has personal knowledge—and personal knowledge can be established by the witness’s own testimony (or other means)—the plaintiff need not do anything prior to testifying.*

*Although the plaintiff’s testimony is admissible, there may be a rebuttable presumption that the model was unfavorable to the plaintiff because she destroyed that evidence. However, this presumption goes only to the weight of the evidence and does not require that the plaintiff take action before testifying.

(Choice A) A party need not provide advance notice of his/her intent to orally testify.

(Choice B) The plaintiff would have needed to introduce a photograph of the model or a reliable duplicate to testify to the model’s appearance if the plaintiff learned of the model’s appearance through a photograph (not seen here).

(Choice C) The plaintiff need not show that she did not destroy the model in bad faith in order to testify. Instead, she need do nothing because the best evidence rule applies only to writings, recordings, and photographs—not to the plaintiff’s testimony about her personal knowledge of the model’s appearance.

📌 Educational Objective

The best evidence rule applies only when the contents of a recording, writing, or photograph are at issue—not when a witness is testifying based on personal knowledge.

📚 References
  • Fed. R. Evid. 1002–04 (best evidence rule).
  • Fed. R. Evid. 602 (personal knowledge requirement).

原告起诉被告，指控其非法将原告的动物机器人创意用于被告的科幻电影中的一个角色。被告承认曾从原告处收到一个动物机器人模型，但否认该模型与电影角色有任何实质性相似之处。在模型归还给原告后，她将其销毁了。

如果原告希望就该模型的外观作证，她在作证前必须做什么？

zh-choices.A: 原告必须就其引入言词证据的意图提前发出通知。
zh-choices.B: 如果存在模型的照片，原告必须出示该照片。
zh-choices.C: 原告必须证明她并非出于恶意销毁该模型。
zh-choices.D: 原告无需做任何事情，因为“最佳证据规则”仅适用于书面文件、录音和照片。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Evidence: Writings, Recordings, and Photographs - Best evidence rule

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：最佳证据规则（best evidence rule）只管用来证明写作、录音、照片（writings, recordings, photographs）的内容，不管证人用自己的亲眼所见作证。

三秒认题路径：

亲眼见过 → 讲外观 → 非内容争议 → 不触发规则 → 直接作证

核心法律规则

最佳证据规则（best evidence rule）只在当事人要证明写作、录音、照片（writings, recordings, photographs）“本身内容”时才上场，考场意思：你是在拿文件内容当证据，不是在讲自己记得什么。

如果证人是基于个人知识（personal knowledge）作证，考场意思：她自己看过、摸过、记得，就可以直接说，不必先拿出原件或可靠副本。

原件被毁这一点，只有在你真的要证明“那份材料的内容”时才会变成问题；本题里，问题是模型长什么样，不是模型“写了什么”。

核心判例：无须特定判例，本题直接套用 FRE 1002-1004 与 FRE 602：证人用个人知识描述外观时，不触发最佳证据规则。

思维导图

先问：她是在证明“模型内容”吗？
否
她只是讲自己见过的外观，走 个人知识（personal knowledge）。
所以
不需要原件、照片或可靠副本先行入证。
结论
直接作证，选 D
只有当
争的是“文书内容”时，才会卡到 FRE 1002。
例如
证明合同条款 / 图片内容 / 录音内容

考点陷阱

你可能会想：模型都被她自己毁了，法院会不会先要求她补交原件或照片。

但考试真正问的是：她现在说的是自己对模型外观的记忆，不是要证明一份“文件内容”。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的证据有没有被毁」。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 D？

题干的 testify to the model's appearance 说的是她自己的观察记忆，不是证明某个写作或照片的内容，所以不触发最佳证据规则。

❌ 概念混淆 | 先行通知误判

✕ A: 把口头作证误当成要先 advance notice。

❌ 法律适用 | 照片替代误判

✕ B: 以为只要有 a photograph 就必须先交出来。

❌ 事实误判 | 恶意毁灭偷换

✕ C: 这里不在考她毁模型是否 bad faith。

这题建议用什么方法？

先分清“证内容”还是“证亲眼所见”，再决定要不要碰最佳证据规则。

考场速记

记住一句话：最佳证据规则（best evidence rule）只管“内容争议”，不管“个人记忆作证”。

看到证人只是讲自己见过什么，先别找原件；先问她是不是在证明文书、录音或照片的内容。

reason.en: The disputed item is a tangible model, not a writing, recording, or photograph.
reason.zh: 争议标的是有形模型，而非文书、录音或照片。

reason.en: May tempt examinees to import bad-faith or spoliation requirements before testimony.
reason.zh: 易诱使考生误以为作证前须先证明无恶意毁证。

reason.en: Witness seeks to prove appearance through firsthand observation, not document contents.
reason.zh: 证人欲以亲身观察证明外观，而非证明文件内容。

reason.en: Frames the underlying dispute but does not trigger the best evidence rule.
reason.zh: 界定案件争议，但不触发最佳证据规则。

reason.en: Asks what precondition must be satisfied before oral testimony is offered.
reason.zh: 询问提供口头证言前须满足何种前提。

reason.en: Invents a notice obligation not required for ordinary oral testimony.
reason.zh: 虚构口头证言并不需要的通知义务。

reason.en: Distractor treats oral testimony as if it were documentary proof.
reason.zh: 将口头证言误当作文件式证明处理。

reason.en: Applies best evidence logic only if appearance were learned from a photograph.
reason.zh: 仅当外观系由照片获知时才适用最佳证据逻辑。

C.text: destroy the model in bad faith

reason.en: Confuses a lost-original exception with a precondition to testify.
reason.zh: 将原件灭失例外误当作作证前提。

reason.en: Correct answer turns on the rule's limited scope.
reason.zh: 正确答案取决于该规则的有限适用范围。

reason.en: Defines the only categories to which the rule applies.
reason.zh: 界定规则仅适用于哪些证据类型。

highlights.text: testify to the model's appearance

reason.en: Personal observation testimony does not require producing an original document.
reason.zh: 基于亲身观察的证言无须出示文件原件。

highlights.text: she destroyed it

reason.en: Destruction may suggest spoliation issues but does not bar pretrial testimony here.
reason.zh: 毁损可能涉及证据保全问题，但不妨碍此处作证前无须额外步骤。

highlights.text: model of an animal robot

reason.en: A physical model is outside writings, recordings, and photographs.
reason.zh: 实体模型不属于文书、录音或照片。

highlights.text: what must she do prior to testifying?

reason.en: The question tests whether any precondition is required before offering testimony.
reason.zh: 本题考查提供证言前是否须满足任何前置条件。

questions.subject: Evidence
questions.question:
A plaintiff sued a defendant over title to land on a riverbank. Changes in the water level over time were important to the plaintiff's case.
For 15 years, a commercial fisherman had kept a daily log of the water level at his dock on the riverbank opposite the land in order to forecast fishing conditions. The plaintiff hired a draftsman to graph the data from the fisherman's logs for use as a trial exhibit.
At trial, the fisherman testified to the care with which he had made the measurements and recorded them in his logs, which had been made available for the defendant's inspection. The draftsman then testified to the manner in which he had prepared the graphs.
With this foundation, are the graphs admissible?

choices.A: No, because they are hearsay not within any exception.
choices.B: No, because they violate the "best evidence" rule.
choices.C: Yes, as summaries of voluminous business records.
choices.D: Yes, as the draftsman's expert opinion of the water levels.

questions.explanation:
Summaries to prove content
(FRE 1006)

Proponent of writings, recordings, or photographs may use summary, chart, or calculation to prove contents if proponent establishes:

  • originals are voluminous & cannot be conveniently examined in court
  • originals would be admissible
  • originals or duplicates were made available for other parties to examine/copy and
  • summary is fair & accurate
FRE = Federal Rule of Evidence.

A party may offer a summary (or chart or calculation) to prove the contents of voluminous writings, recordings, or photographs if a proper foundation for admitting the summary is laid. This requires the summary's proponent to establish that:

  • the originals are voluminous and cannot be conveniently examined in court (eg, 15 years of daily logs)
  • the originals would be admissible (eg, the fisherman's logs are admissible business records商业记录例外 (Business Records Exception, FRE 803(6))：在常规业务过程中制作并保存的记录，在满足特定条件下可采纳为证据，属于传闻证据的例外。)
  • the originals or duplicates were made available to all parties to examine and copy† (as seen here) and
  • the summary is fair and accurate (as established by the fisherman's and draftsman's testimony).

Therefore, the graphs of the data from the fisherman's voluminous logs are admissible with this foundation.

†The examination and copying must occur at a reasonable time and place OR at trial in response to a court order.

(Choice A) Although the fisherman's daily logs are out-of-court writings that implicate the hearsay rule, they would be admissible under the business records hearsay exception. And the graphs summarizing this voluminous business data are also admissible because the proper foundation has been laid.

(Choice B) The "best evidence" rule requires that an original writing, recording, or photograph be produced in order to prove its contents. But summaries of voluminous information are excepted from this rule so long as the originals are made available for inspection to all parties (as seen here).

(Choice D) Expert testimony from a qualified person with specialized knowledge is admissible if that testimony is relevant to the litigated issue. But here, there is no indication that the draftsman is an expert on measuring water levels merely because he graphed data from the fisherman's logs for use as a trial exhibit.

📌 Educational Objective

The foundation for admitting a summary, chart, or calculation of voluminous content is laid when the proponent shows that (1) the voluminous content cannot be conveniently examined in court, (2) the originals would be admissible, (3) the content was made available to all parties, and (4) the summary is fair and accurate.

📚 References
  • Fed. R. Evid. 1006 (summaries to prove content).

原告就被告一块河岸土地的所有权提起诉讼。随着时间推移，水位的变化对原告的案件至关重要。

十五年来，一名商业渔民为了预测渔情，每天都会在他位于该土地对岸河岸的码头记录水位。原告聘请了一名绘图员，将渔民日志中的数据绘制成图表，用作庭审证物。

庭审时，渔民就其测量和记录日志的谨慎过程作证，这些日志已提供给被告查阅。随后，绘图员就其制作图表的方式作证。

在有此基础的情况下，这些图表可以采纳为证据吗？

zh-choices.A: 不可以，因为它们是传闻证据，且不属于任何例外情况。
zh-choices.B: 不可以，因为它们违反了“最佳证据规则”。
zh-choices.C: 可以，作为对大量商业记录的摘要。
zh-choices.D: 可以，作为绘图员对水位的专家意见。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Evidence: Writings, Recordings, and Photographs - Best evidence rule

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：1006号规则（FRE 1006）下，可用总结、图表或计算（summary, chart, or calculation）把海量原始记录做成图表，前提是基础铺好，不是死卡 最佳证据规则（best evidence rule）。

三秒认题路径：

海量日志 → 原件可采 → 提前开放 → 总结准确 → 可入证

核心法律规则

这条规则怎么用

当原始材料太多，法庭不方便一页页看时，总结（summary）、图表（chart）或计算（calculation）可以直接用来证明内容。考场意思：你不是在偷偷绕开证据，而是在用更省时的方式把一大堆可采资料搬进法庭。

但前提是：原件必须数量庞大（voluminous），原件本身得是可采的，且已在合理时间地点让对方检查和复制，最后总结还要公平且准确（fair and accurate）。

核心规则： FRE 1006 允许用总结证明海量文件内容，只要基础条件都满足；本题的鱼贩日志就是典型的可总结材料。

思维导图

先看：这是不是要把一堆原始记录直接搬进法庭？
是原始日志有 15 年，量太大，法庭不可能逐页审。
再看：原件本身能不能进证？
能捕鱼日志属 business records，先天可采。
再看：对方有没有提前看过原件/复印件？
有日志已供对方检查和复制，程序门槛过了。
最后一关：总结是不是公平准确？
这里通过：测量人和制图人都说明方法可靠，图表可用。
结论：图表不是被 best evidence rule 卡死，而是 FRE 1006 允许的总结证据。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：这只是把原始日志改成图表，应该先问是不是 hearsay 或者是不是必须拿原件出来。

但考试真正问的是：海量材料能不能用 summary 代替逐页出示，基础有没有铺好。

司法考试看的是「程序上能不能用总结证明内容」，而不是「你是不是必须把每一页原件都当庭展开」。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 C？

题干的 15 年日常日志 量太大，且原件已可供检查；鱼贩又证明了记录可靠，所以图表属于可采的海量记录总结。

❌ 概念混淆 | 传闻混为一谈

✕ A: 把日志先贴上 hearsay 标签就结束了，漏看了商业记录例外。

❌ 法律适用 | 原件规则误套

✕ B: 以为 best evidence 一定逼原件出庭，忘了海量总结本来就是例外。

❌ 事实误判 | 专家身份偷换

questions.subject: Evidence
questions.question:
A defendant has been charged with federal tax evasion after failing to pay an alleged deficiency in his personal income taxes. The defendant has pleaded not guilty, claiming that the deficiency resulted from the IRS's erroneous disallowance of deductions for charitable contributions that the defendant made to a local church. At trial, the defendant sought to introduce copies of the checks he claimed to have written to the church. After pointing out that the copies of the front of the checks did not quite match copies of the back of the checks, the prosecutor objected to their introduction on grounds that they violated the best evidence rule.
Should the court admit the copies of the checks?

choices.A: No, because a genuine question has been raised about the authenticity of the original checks.
choices.B: No, because the defendant did not account for the absence of the original checks.
choices.C: Yes, because copies of the checks are admissible to the same extent as originals.
choices.D: Yes, because the jury determines whether the original checks are authentic.

questions.explanation:
Overview of the best evidence rule.
General rule
Must produce original or reliable duplicate* to prove contents of document relied on by witness or whose contents are at issue.

Exceptions

Original unavailable: Other evidence can be used to prove contents if:
  • originals lost or destroyed (not by proponent's bad faith)
  • original not attainable by judicial process
  • opponent had original, knew it was required & failed to produce it or
  • content not closely related to controlling issue
Admission by party: Contents of document can be proved by opposing party's testimony, deposition, or written statement
Public record: Contents of public record can be proved by:
  • certified copy
  • copy of record + comparison testimony or
  • other evidence if above proof is not reasonably obtainable

*Duplicates are admissible unless the original's authenticity is questioned or it would be unfair to admit them.

The best evidence rule requires that an original or reliable duplicate of a recording, writing, or photograph be produced to prove its contents. But a duplicate is not admissible if:

  • a genuine question is raised about the original's authenticity or
  • circumstances make it unfair to admit the duplicate (eg, when only part of the original is duplicated).

Here, the defendant seeks to introduce copies of the checks to prove that he made charitable contributions to a local church. After the prosecutor pointed out that the copies of the front of the checks did not quite match copies of the back of the checks, a genuine question was raised about the authenticity of the original checks. Therefore, the court should not admit the copies of the checks over the prosecutor's objection. Copies of the checks are not admissible to the same extent as originals when a genuine question is raised about the original's authenticity (Choice C).

(Choice B) A party is not required to account for an original's absence before introducing a duplicate to prove a document's contents. A duplicate is generally admissible without accounting for the original's absence unless a genuine question is raised about the original's authenticity or it would be unfair to admit the duplicate.

(Choice D) Whether a genuine question has been raised about an original's authenticity is a determination for the court, not the jury. The jury determines the weight to be given to the evidence after it is admitted.

📌 Educational Objective

Under the best evidence rule, a duplicate of a recording, writing, or photograph is admissible to prove its contents unless (1) a genuine question is raised about the original's authenticity or (2) circumstances make it unfair to admit the duplicate.

📚 References
  • Fed. R. Evid. 1002–07 (best evidence rule).

MBE 考点解析

Evidence: Writings, Recordings, and Photographs - Requirement of original

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：复印件能不能代替原件证明支票内容；一旦原件真实性被认真质疑，duplicate 就不能直接过关。

三秒认题路径：

支票复印件 → 证内容 → 原件真伪起疑 → 不让替代 → 选 A

核心法律规则

最小够用规则

最佳证据规则（best evidence rule）要求用原件（original）或可靠复制件reliable duplicate来证明文件内容；但复制件（duplicate）一般可以用，前提是原件没有被真正质疑。

如果对原件的真实性（authenticity）出现了genuine question，或者让复制件进入会不公平，法庭就可以拒绝复制件。考场意思：这里不是问“有没有原件”，而是问“这个复印件还能不能放心拿来证明内容”。

核心判例：本题对应 Fed. R. Evid. 1002–07 的规则框架：复制件通常可用，但原件真实性被认真质疑时，复制件会被挡下。

思维导图

先问：题目是不是要用支票复印件去证明“支票写了什么”？
是 进入 最佳证据规则（best evidence rule）。
默认 复制件（duplicate）通常可以顶上去。
但要卡 如果对原件真实性（authenticity）冒出genuine question，复制件就不能照常用。
卡死点：这里已经有“前后页对不上”的异常，说明原件真伪被认真怀疑，不能放行复制件。
结论 复印件不进证，答案选 A。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：既然只是复印件，法院是不是要先看看原件丢没丢、能不能找回。

但考试真正问的是：复制件能不能在“原件真实性已被质疑”时继续证明内容，不是先追问原件缺不缺席。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的秘密有没有泄露」。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 A？

题干里前后两面的复印件对不上，已经把原件真实性拉进争议；一旦真伪被认真质疑，复制件就不能直接用来证明内容。

❌ 事实误判 | 原件缺席偷换

✕ B: 误以为一定要先交代 absence of the original，其实这里不靠这个门槛。

❌ 法律适用 | 复制件泛化

✕ C: 把 admissible to the same extent 当成绝对规则，忽略了真实性被质疑的例外。

❌ 概念混淆 | 裁判者错位

✕ D: 以为由陪审团先判断真伪，但这道门槛先由法官决定，陪审团只管权重。

这题建议用什么方法？

先看题干有没有在“证内容”，再抓原件真伪是否被点燃；有质疑就先拦 duplicate。

考场速记

记住一句：复制件默认可用，原件真伪一被认真挑战就先停。这类题先找“真实性（authenticity）有没有被戳穿”，再决定要不要放行复印件。

questions.subject: Evidence
questions.question:
A defendant has been charged with making false statements to a financial institution in order to obtain a loan. The government alleges that the defendant misrepresented the value of foreign treasury bonds he wished to use as collateral for the loan. To support that contention at trial, the prosecutor called a foreign banker to testify to the content of a document created by an overseas bond-rating company that is not subject to judicial process. The document, which was not produced at trial, contained the actual values of the defendant's bonds. The actual values of the bonds were much lower than what the defendant stated on his loan application.
The defendant has objected on the ground that the banker's testimony violates the best evidence rule.
Which of the following, if established, would best support admission of the banker's testimony?

choices.A: The banker is an expert in the valuation of treasury bonds.
choices.B: The defendant was given notice that the prosecution would seek to introduce the content of the document at trial.
choices.C: The document was easily obtainable by the defendant prior to trial.
choices.D: The document was not obtainable via subpoena or other judicial process.

questions.explanation:
Original document unobtainable by judicial process (FRE 1004(b))

Examples of when original cannot be obtained by judicial process include:

  • foreign third party not subject to court’s subpoena power in possession of original
  • proponent unable to locate & serve person in possession of original
  • person in possession of original served but fails/refuses to produce original
  • third party asserts claim of privilege as to original
FRE = Federal Rule of Evidence.

The best evidence rule (or original document rule) applies when a witness relies on a document’s contents while testifying or when the contents of a document are at issue. This rule generally requires that an original or reliable duplicate of a recording, writing, or photograph (referred to as the “document”) be produced to prove its contents.

However, an exception allows other evidence of the document’s content (eg, testimony) to be admitted when the original (1) is in the possession of a person or entity that is not a party to the litigation and (2) cannot be obtained by any available judicial process. For example, an original may be in the possession of a foreign third party that is not subject to the court’s subpoena power.

*A third party located abroad who is neither a national nor a resident of the United States is beyond the subpoena power of a federal district court.*

(Choice A) Although the banker’s expertise in the valuation of treasury bonds might provide a basis for opinion testimony concerning the value of the defendant’s bonds, it does not provide a basis for admitting testimony about the content of a document created by a bond-rating company.

(Choices B & C) The proponent (here, the prosecution) must produce the original or establish an exception. Neither notice to the defendant that the prosecution would seek to introduce the content of the document at trial nor the fact that the document was easily obtainable by the defendant prior to trial supports admission of the banker’s testimony.

📌 Educational Objective

One exception to the best evidence rule allows a party to introduce other evidence of a document’s content when the original is in the possession of a person or entity that is not a party to the litigation and cannot be obtained by any available judicial process.

📚 References
  • Fed. R. Evid. 1002–07 (best evidence rule).

MBE 考点解析

Evidence: Writings, Recordings, and Photographs - Requirement of original

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：最佳证据规则（best evidence rule）下，原件拿不到时，能不能用其他证据替代证明文件内容。

三秒认题路径：

问文件内容 → 要原件 → 原件拿不到 → 看例外 → 选 D

核心法律规则

先抓住规则门槛

当证人是靠文件内容（contents of a writing）来作证，或者题目争的就是文件里写了什么时，通常要交原件（original）或可靠副本。考场意思：你不是在问“这人懂不懂”，而是在问“这份纸上到底写了什么”。

但如果原件在非当事第三方（person not a party）手里，而且无法通过任何司法程序取得（cannot be obtained by judicial process），就可以用别的证据证明内容。考场意思：法院拿不到原件时，不会逼你做不可能的事。

核心判例： FRE 1004(b) - 原件在境外第三方手里、又拿不到时，替代性证据可以进来。

思维导图

题目先问：证人是不是在证明“文件内容”？
是先触发原件规则（original document rule）。
再看原件在哪：
原件在境外第三方手里，而且不受法院传票权控制。
卡死点：原件unobtainable by judicial process。
结果可用其他证据证明内容，银行家可作证。
别走错“专家会估值”不等于“能替代文件内容”；“对方提前知道”也不是例外。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：银行家既然懂债券估值，那他应该可以直接说这份文件里的数值。

但考试真正问的是：他能不能绕开原件规则来证明“文件内容”，不是他懂不懂市场价值。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的秘密有没有泄露」。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 D？

题干关键事实是海外 bond-rating company 的原件不受传票强制，正好落入FRE 1004(b)的例外，所以可用银行家证言证明文件内容。

❌ 概念混淆 | 估值权能误判

✕ A: 把expert当成能替代原件的人了。

❌ 法律适用 | 通知要件误判

✕ B: 提前通知不是best evidence的例外。

❌ 事实误判 | 取证便利误判

✕ C: easily obtainable 看的是原件能否取得，不看被告好不好拿到。

这题建议用什么方法？

先看是不是在证明文件内容，再查原件是否真的拿不到，最后才判断能否用替代证据。

考场速记

记住这句：“文件内容要原件；原件拿不到，才轮到替代证据。” 看到境外第三方、传票够不着，就立刻想到 FRE 1004(b)。

questions.question:
A plaintiff sued a defendant for breach of contract, alleging that the defendant violated the terms of an employment contract between the parties. At trial, without offering the contract or accounting for its absence, the plaintiff seeks to admit an oral statement that the defendant made to an acquaintance in which the defendant recited the terms of the contract.
The defendant has objected to the oral statement on the ground that it violates the best evidence rule.
Should the court admit the defendant's oral statement?

choices.A: No, because a statement by a party-opponent cannot serve as a basis to prove the content of a writing.
choices.B: No, because the plaintiff did not account for the contract's absence.
choices.C: Yes, because the best evidence rule is not implicated.
choices.D: Yes, because the contract's terms can be proved by the defendant's statement.

questions.explanation:
Overview of best evidence rule
General rule Must produce original or reliable duplicate* to prove contents of document relied on by witness or whose contents are at issue
Exceptions
Other evidence can be used to prove content if:
Original unavailable
  • originals lost or destroyed (not by proponent's bad faith)
  • originals not attainable by judicial process
  • opponent had original, knew it was required & failed to produce
  • or content not closely related to controlling issue
Admission by party Contents can be proven by opposing party's testimony, deposition, or written statement
Public record Contents of public record can be proven by:
  • certified copy
  • copy of records & comparison testimony
  • or other evidence if above proof is not reasonably obtainable

*Duplicates are admissible unless original's authenticity is questioned or it would be unfair to admit them.

The best evidence rule (ie, original document rule) generally requires that an original or reliable duplicate of a recording, writing, or photograph (referred to as "document") be produced to prove its content. The rule is implicated when a document's contents are at issue, such as when the document has a legal effect (eg, contracts, wills) (Choice C). However, a common exception requires the proponent of the evidence to prove that all originals are lost, destroyed, or otherwise unattainable before allowing the use of other evidence to prove the document's contents.

Another exception allows a party to prove a document's contents through the testimony, deposition, or written statement of a party-opponent without accounting for the original document's absence (Choice A). However, an oral statement made outside of testimony/deposition does not fall under this exception.

Here, the plaintiff tried to admit an oral statement that the defendant made to an acquaintance in which the defendant recited the terms of the contract. Therefore, it does not fall under the exception allowing a party to prove a document's contents through a party-opponent's testimony, deposition, or written statement (Choice D). Because the plaintiff did not account for the contract's absence, the statement is inadmissible.

📌 Educational Objective

The best evidence rule requires that an original or reliable duplicate of a recording, writing, or photograph be produced to prove its contents. But one exception allows a party to instead prove the contents of a document through the testimony, deposition, or written statement of the party against whom the evidence is offered. An oral statement made outside of testimony or a deposition does not fall under this exception.

📚 References
  • Fed. R. Evid. 1002–07 (best evidence rule).

MBE 考点解析

Evidence: Writings, Recordings, and Photographs - Requirement of original

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：用口头转述去证明合同内容时，最佳证据规则（best evidence rule）通常要求先交代原件为什么不在，不能直接拿第三人转述顶上。

三秒认题路径：

合同内容被争议 → 想证明文字内容 → 先看原件 → 没交代缺失 → 不能进

核心法律规则

考场上先记这条

最佳证据规则（best evidence rule）要求用原件或可靠副本去证明写作物、录音、照片（writing, recording, photograph）的内容；考场意思：一旦争的是“纸上到底写了什么”，就先别急着用别的证据替代。

当事人陈述（admission by party-opponent）确实能替代证明书面内容，但考场意思：它通常得是对方的证言（testimony）、证词笔录（deposition）或书面陈述（written statement），不是场外随口聊天。

所以这题里，口头转述不是该例外；而且原告又没有先交代合同原件为何缺失，法院就应当拒绝这段话。

核心判例： 没有本题必需的特定判例；这题直接按 FRE 1002–1007 的原件规则与例外判断即可。

思维导图

先问：这句口头话是不是在证明合同内容（content of the writing）？
是合同条款本身在争议中，说明已触发最佳证据规则（best evidence rule）。
下一关原件或可靠副本有没有拿出来？
没有，而且也没先交代原件丢失、毁损或其他缺失理由。
再查例外能不能靠当事人陈述（admission by party-opponent）绕过？
卡死点只能是证言、证词笔录或书面陈述；对熟人随口说的口头转述不算。
结论：证据先被原件规则拦下，答案走 No。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：既然是对方自己说过合同条款，那就能直接拿来证明内容。

但考试真正问的是：这句话是不是落在当事人陈述例外（admission by party-opponent exception）的范围里；这里是场外口头转述，不是证言、证词笔录或书面陈述。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「口头复述听起来像不像真的」。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 B？

题干要用口头转述证明合同条款内容，却没有先交代原件为何缺失；最佳证据规则先卡住，所以应判不采。

❌ 概念混淆 | 规则渊源误判

✕ A: 把party-opponent当成万能钥匙了，口头闲聊不算这里的例外。

❌ 法律适用 | 规则触发误判

✕ C: 以为只要不是原件就能随便绕开，其实这正是最佳证据规则被触发。

❌ 事实误判 | 口头陈述偷换

✕ D: 把oral statement偷换成书面陈述，题干根本没给这种形式。

这题建议用什么方法？

先看是不是在证明文字内容，再查有没有原件或能不能落入例外。

考场速记

记忆口诀：先原件，后例外；先看写了什么，再看谁说了什么。这题的关键不是“谁说过”，而是“能不能拿场外口头话去替代文书内容”。

questions.subject: Evidence
questions.question:
A corporation sued a defendant for 10 fuel oil deliveries not paid for. The defendant denied that the deliveries were made.
At trial, the corporation calls its office manager to testify that the corporation's employees always record each delivery in duplicate, give one copy to the customer, and place the other copy in the corporate files; that he is the custodian of those files; and that his examination of the files before coming to court revealed that the 10 deliveries were made.
Is the office manager's testimony that the invoices show 10 deliveries admissible?

choices.A: No, because the records are self-serving.
choices.B: No, because the records must be produced in order to prove their contents.
choices.C: Yes, because it is based on regularly kept business records.
choices.D: Yes, because the office manager has firsthand knowledge of the contents of the records.

questions.explanation:
Best evidence rule

(FRE 1001–04)
Are contents of writing, recording, or photograph at issue—ie:
  • Content used to prove happening of event
  • Content has a legal effect or
  • Witness is testifying to facts learned from content
No Rule does not apply
Yes
Do any of the following apply:
  • All originals lost or destroyed by means other than proponent's bad faith
  • Original could not be obtained by judicial process
  • Opponent had control of original and notice that it was required at trial, but failed to produce
  • Content not closely related to controlling issue
Yes Rule does not apply
No
Rule applies (original or reliable duplicate required)
FRE = Federal Rules of Evidence

Under the best evidence rule, an original or reliable duplicate of a recording, writing, or photograph (collectively referred to as "document") must generally be produced to prove its contents. As a result, this rule only applies when a document's contents are at issue - ie, when:

  • the document is used to prove that an event occurred (eg, police incident report)
  • the document has a legal effect (eg, contract, will, power of attorney) or
  • the witness is testifying based on facts learned from the document, as opposed to personal knowledge (ie, knowledge based on firsthand observations or experience)

Here, the office manager learned of the 10 deliveries by examining the invoices that had been placed in the corporate files before coming to court - not through personal knowledge. As a result, the contents of those records cannot be proved through the office manager's testimony. Instead, an original or reliable duplicate of those records must be produced to prove their contents.

(Choice A) A document is self-serving if it primarily contains information that is helpful to its proponent. But this, without more, does not affect the admissibility of the document or related testimony.

(Choice C) The invoices are admissible under the business records exception to the hearsay rule because a corporate employee recorded each delivery as a regular practice of the corporation. But the office manager's testimony to the contents of the invoices is inadmissible unless the invoice records are produced.

(Choice D) The office manager would have had firsthand knowledge of the contents of the records had he, for example, personally observed the disputed deliveries. Merely examining the files before coming to court is not sufficient for him to testify to their contents.

📌 Educational Objective

The best evidence rule only applies when the contents of a recording, writing, or photograph are at issue - eg, when a witness testifies based on facts learned from a document, as opposed to personal knowledge.

📚 References
  • Fed. R. Evid. 1002–04 (best evidence rule).

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Evidence: Writings, Recordings, and Photographs - Best evidence rule

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：当证人是根据书面记录（writing）里的内容来证明“发生了什么”时，必须先交出原件或可靠副本，不能只靠口头转述。

三秒认题路径：

看文件内容 → 证明发生过 → 不是亲眼见到 → 要原件 → 选不能口头证明

核心法律规则

最短可用规则

最佳证据规则（best evidence rule）考场意思：当争点是文件内容（contents）本身时，原件（original）或可靠副本通常要拿出来。这里的关键不是这份票据“真不真”，而是证人是不是想靠看过文件后再转述文件内容。

业务记录（business records）例外只解决传闻证据（hearsay）问题，考场意思：它不自动放行你用口头证言去证明记录内容。办公室经理（office manager）只是看文件后知道结果，不是自己亲眼看见交货，所以不能只凭他的叙述证明那10次送货。

核心判例： Mohawk Industries v. Carpenter 不属于本题；本题锁定的是 FRE 1002–1004：要证明文件内容，就要先出示原件或可靠副本。

思维导图

先问：证人要证明的是“送货真的发生过”，还是“文件里写了什么”?
如果是靠看过发票后才知道“有10次送货”，这就是在证明writing 的内容。
卡死点：不是亲身感知，而是文件内容；所以不能只用口头证言。
再看有没有拿出原件或可靠副本？
没有原件/可靠副本 → best evidence rule 直接要求补文件。
如果是自己亲眼看到油料被送到，就属于个人感知；这时不靠文件内容，规则不拦。
本题结论办公室经理只是检查档案得知内容，不能替代发票本身。
答案：B，必须生产记录来证明其内容。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：这家公司的发票是日常做出来的，像business records，那经理当然可以讲。

但考试真正问的是：你现在是不是在拿“文件里写了什么”当证据，而不是拿“他本人看见了什么”当证据。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的秘密有没有泄露」。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 B？

题干先看档案、再下结论，说明经理是在证明发票内容；要证明这种内容，必须先交出原件或可靠副本。

❌ 概念混淆 | 规则渊源误判

✕ A: 把self-serving当成排除理由了，但这不是本题的门槛。

❌ 法律适用 | 记录例外误判

✕ C: 只看到business records，却忽略还得把记录本身拿出来。

❌ 事实误判 | 亲历事实偷换

✕ D: 经理没有亲眼送货，不能把firsthand knowledge硬说成有。

这题建议用什么方法？

先分清“亲眼知道”还是“看文件才知道”，再决定是否触发 best evidence rule。

考场速记

记住一句话：要证明文件内容，就先拿文件本身。看到证人是“看完记录再说”的，先想最佳证据规则，而不是先想业务记录例外。

questions.subject: Evidence
questions.question:
A defendant has been charged with tax evasion. The government alleges that the defendant created numerous sham trusts to hide his income and, over the course of several years, made thousands of wire transfers to those trusts. During discovery, the government produced a summary of the wire transfer statements and notified the defendant of its intent to introduce the summary to prove the contents of the statements. The government also made the authenticated wire transfer statements available for inspection at its office.
At trial, the government called the investigating IRS agent to testify. After laying a proper foundation, the government sought to introduce the summary of the wire transfer statements as substantive evidence of the defendant's tax evasion. The defendant has objected to its introduction.
Should the court admit the summary?

choices.A: No, because the summary cannot be admitted as substantive evidence.
choices.B: No, because the wire transfer statements must be produced in court.
choices.C: Yes, because the government made the original wire transfer statements available before trial.
choices.D: Yes, because the summary is a business record.

questions.explanation:
Summaries to prove content
(FRE 1006)

Proponent of writings, recordings, or photographs may use summary, chart, or calculation to prove contents if proponent establishes:

  • originals are voluminous & cannot be conveniently examined in court
  • originals would be admissible
  • originals or duplicates were made available for other parties to examine/copy and
  • summary is fair & accurate
FRE = Federal Rule of Evidence.

Under the best evidence rule, an original or reliable duplicate of a writing, recording, or photograph must generally be produced to prove its contents.

FRE 1006 provides an exception to the best evidence rule for voluminous writings. A party may use a summary, chart, or calculation to prove the contents of writings that are too voluminous to be conveniently examined in court if the proponent establishes that the originals would be admissible, the originals or duplicates available to other parties for examination, copying, and the summary is fair and accurate. The originals or duplicates need not be produced in court unless ordered by the court (Choice B).

A summary that satisfies the requirements of FRE 1006 may be admitted substantively to prove the contents of the underlying writings, recordings, or photographs. This is different from a demonstrative aid, which merely illustrates other evidence and is not itself substantive evidence. Although the underlying wire transfer statements would likely qualify as business records, the summary itself is not a business record (Choice A).

Here, the government sought to introduce a summary of the wire transfer statements as substantive evidence of the defendant's tax evasion. The wire transfer statements are voluminous (eg, thousands of transfers over several years) and would be admissible as business records. The government made authenticated wire transfer statements available for the defendant's inspection at its office before trial, and a proper foundation for the summary was laid through the investigating IRS agent's testimony. Therefore, the summary is admissible.

(Choice D) The summary is not itself a business record because it was prepared in anticipation of litigation. But it is admissible under FRE 1006 because the underlying wire transfer statements would be admissible as business records and the other requirements of the rule have been satisfied.

📌 Educational Objective

A summary, chart, or calculation may be used to prove the contents of the documents it summarizes if the contents are too voluminous to be conveniently examined in court. The originals or duplicates must be made available to an adverse party for examination or copying, but they need not be produced in court unless ordered by the court.

📚 References
  • Fed. R. Evid. 1006 (summaries).

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Evidence: Writings, Recordings, and Photographs - Summaries

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：FRE 1006 的 summary to prove content 能不能作为实体证据进庭，而不是要求把每一份原件都搬到法庭里。

三秒认题路径：

海量记录 → 先给检查 → 可用摘要 → 原件不必出庭 → 可采

核心法律规则

只抓这条规则

当写作、记录或照片太多，法庭里不方便逐份看时，摘要（summary）、图表（chart）或计算（calculation）可以用来证明内容，这就是 FRE 1006 的例外。考场意思：只要原件本来可采、已经让对方有机会检查或复制，而且摘要公平准确，就能进来当实体证据。

这里最关键的不是“原件有没有在庭上”，而是“原件或副本有没有先开放给对方查阅”。business records（业务记录） 是底层材料可采的来源，但摘要本身不需要是业务记录。

核心判例： Fed. R. Evid. 1006 — 先满足海量、可采、可查阅、准确这四步，摘要就能作为实体证据使用。

思维导图

题干先看：几千笔 wire transfer，记录太多，法庭不想一张张翻。
第1步：是不是 FRE 1006 的海量记录？
是 → 可以用 summary，不要求每份原件都进庭
第2步：底层原件能不能被对方查？
政府已在庭前把 authenticated statements 放在办公室供检查
第3步：底层材料本身可采吗？
可以，wire transfer statements 可走 business records
最后：摘要公平准确且已打 foundation 吗？
是 → 选 C，摘要可作实体证据进入

考点陷阱

你可能会想：既然是 summary，那它只是“辅助材料”，不能单独当证据。

但考试真正问的是：FRE 1006 允许它直接证明海量底层文件的内容；只要原件已可供对方检查，原件不必当庭提交。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的秘密有没有泄露」。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 C？

题干已给出 庭前开放检查 和 proper foundation；海量 wire transfer statements 符合 FRE 1006，所以 summary 可以作为实体证据。

❌ 概念混淆 | 证据性质误判

✕ A: 把 substantive evidence 误当成“不能实体使用”的意思了。

❌ 法律适用 | 当庭出示误判

✕ B: 误以为 must be produced 一定要把原件搬到法庭，忽略了 1006 的例外。

❌ 事实误判 | 业务记录偷换

✕ D: 只盯着 business record，却忘了摘要本身是 1006 许可，不要求它自己就是业务记录。

这题建议用什么方法？

先看是否海量记录，再核对原件是否可查，最后问摘要是不是公平准确。

考场速记

记住一句：海量可采、先给检查、摘要可上，这就是 FRE 1006。遇到 summary 先别慌，先问“原件有没有给对方看过，摘要准不准”。

questions.question:
A defendant is being prosecuted for conspiracy to possess cocaine with intent to distribute. At trial, the government seeks to have its agent testify to a conversation that he overheard between the defendant and a coconspirator regarding the incoming shipment of a large quantity of cocaine. That conversation was also audiotaped, though critical portions of it are inaudible.
The defendant objects to the testimony of the agent on the ground that it is not the best evidence of the conversation.
Is the testimony admissible?

choices.A: No, because the testimony of the agent is not the best evidence of the conversation.
choices.B: No, because the testimony of the agent reports hearsay not within any exception.
choices.C: Yes, because the audiotape is partly inaudible.
choices.D: Yes, because the best evidence rule does not require proof of the conversation through the audiotape.

questions.explanation:
Best evidence rule
(FRE 1002–04)
Original (or reliable duplicate) of writing, recording, or photograph must be produced to prove its content unless:
  • all originals lost or destroyed by means other than proponent acting in bad faith
  • original cannot be obtained by judicial process
  • nonproponent had control of original & notice that original was required at trial or hearing, but failed to produce it
  • writing, recording, or photograph not closely related to controlling issue
FRE = Federal Rules of Evidence.

The best evidence rule generally requires that an original or reliable duplicate of a recording, writing, or photograph (collectively referred to as “document”) be produced to prove its contents. As a result, this rule only applies when a document’s contents are at issue—i.e., when:

  • the document is used to prove happening of an event (e.g., video of bank robbery)
  • the document has a legal effect (e.g., audiotape of oral contract)
  • or the witness is testifying based on facts learned from the document (e.g., x-ray image)

Here, the agent seeks to testify based on his personal knowledge (i.e., what the agent overheard)—not on facts learned from the audiotape. Therefore, the best evidence rule does not apply, and the agent’s testimony is admissible regardless of whether the audiotape is produced (Choice A).

(Choice B) Statements made by or attributable to a party-opponent—e.g., those made by a defendant’s coconspirator—are nonhearsay and admissible if offered against that party. Therefore, the testimony reporting what the defendant and coconspirator said is nonhearsay.

(Choice C) The agent may testify to what he personally heard regardless of whether an audiotape exists or is audible.

📌 Educational Objective

The best evidence rule only applies when a document’s contents are at issue—i.e., when (1) the document is used to prove the happening of an event, (2) the document has a legal effect, or (3) the witness is testifying based on facts learned from the document.

📚 References
  • Fed. R. Evid. 1002–04 (best evidence rule).
  • Fed. R. Evid. 602 (witness’s personal knowledge).

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Evidence: Writings, Recordings, and Photographs - Best evidence rule

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：最佳证据规则（best evidence rule）只管“要用文件内容证明什么”，不管证人是靠自己亲耳听到的事实作证。

三秒认题路径：

证人亲耳听到 → 不是靠录音取材 → 内容未被拿来证明 → 不触发规则 → 可作证

核心法律规则

最佳证据规则（best evidence rule）的考场意思：当事人要拿写作、录音、照片（writing, recording, photograph）的“内容”来证明某件事时，通常要交原件或可靠副本。内容在争点上（contents at issue）才会触发；如果证人只是讲自己亲耳听到、亲眼看到的事，而不是靠文件内容转述，规则就不管。

这里，证人讲的是自己听到的对话，不是拿audiotape来替代记忆，所以即使录音部分听不清，证词仍可采。证人个人知识（personal knowledge）才是关键，录音是否存在或是否清楚（audible）不是这题的卡点。

核心判例： Fed. R. Evid. 1002–04 — 只有在“要证明文件内容”时，才需要原件或可靠副本。

思维导图

先问：证人是在证明recording的内容，还是在讲自己亲耳听到的话？
NO 不是拿录音内容当证明 → 不触发最佳证据规则
结论 证人按个人知识（personal knowledge）作证，哪怕录音有、而且部分听不清，也照样可采。→ 正确答案 D
YES 如果真是要用录音内容证明对话本身，才轮到原件/可靠副本规则；但本题事实没走到这一步。
再卡一层：录音partly inaudible，只会影响清晰度，不会自动把亲耳所闻变成“必须靠录音证明”。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：既然有audiotape，那就应该先交录音，不能让人直接讲。

但考试真正问的是：这次证言是不是在“证明录音内容”。这里证人只是说自己听到的对话，不是从录音里抄答案，所以最佳证据规则不拦。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的秘密有没有泄露」。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 D？

题干里证人说的是自己亲耳听到的对话，不是用录音内容来证明对话内容，所以最佳证据规则不要求先放录音。

❌ 概念混淆 | 把规则当成排他

✕ A: 以为只要有录音，证人就不能讲自己听到的事。

❌ 法律适用 | 误把传闻当卡点

✕ B: 把共犯陈述硬套成传闻阻却问题，忽略本题先问的是最佳证据规则。

❌ 事实误判 | 夸大失真细节

✕ C: 只盯着partly inaudible，误以为听不清就不能作证。

这题建议用什么方法？

先看证人是不是靠文件内容说话；若只是个人所闻，直接跳过最佳证据规则。

考场速记

记住一句：“证人讲自己知道的，不是讲文件写了什么”，就先别急着翻最佳证据规则。

只有当文件内容本身是争点时，才需要原件或可靠副本；亲耳听到的对话，可以直接由证人作证。
